_comment: Book-name normalisation, kept beside bible-wheel-catalog.json because it is
the same kind of thing: source data the app reads, not application code.
The catalog names books the way its author writes them; the bundled World
English Bible uses the traditional titles of the 1901 ASV. Where those two
disagree, this is the bridge. Keys are lower-cased; anything not listed is
already the same on both sides.
It lives at the root rather than in src/ so that scripts/check-no-duplication
still means what it says: no catalog content may appear as a literal inside
src/ or scripts/, and that rule stays absolute rather than acquiring an
